snippet.title: Chillin' by the Fire – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 7.31.2025
snippet.description:
Chillin' by the Fire is now available on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/chillin-by-the-fire-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
Campfires. Humanity's oldest social network.

Enjoy a quiet, low-poly world, where each player's voice blends with the flickering of the campfire. Chillin' by the Fire is a campfire simulation game where you build and maintain campfires in a variety of different relaxing locales including a beach, forest, or snowy mountain top. To add to the challenge, each location has differing weather and climate that players must keep in mind when growing their campfire.

Up to four players can gather around the same fire. So, whether you're spending a quiet night alone or catching up with faraway friends, you can bring a gentle warmth into your everyday life. With an external camera connected, you can even video chat with the game feature, CameraPlay.

In a world that’s always rushing, slow down and reclaim the simple joy of just sitting around and watching a campfire grow.

#ChillinbytheFire #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
